steps.action: Open each of the six assigned case-study routes from default load
steps.expected: A top-of-page decision summary is visible with business question, conclusion, key output, evidence line, and limitation language
steps.observed: All six routes exposed top summary content from default load; route scans found Business question, Bottom line, and Limitation text on every route, with ORD-LGA explicitly labeling the section War-Room BLUF.

assertions.title: Every case study exposes inspectable trust/provenance UI

steps.action: Inspect each route from default page load for trust/provenance affordances and text
steps.expected: Each route exposes trust/provenance UI that identifies evidence state such as real, mixed, modeled, fallback, stale, or unavailable

assertions.title: Current-run trust details are auditable from the route UI

steps.action: Inspect trust detail content across the six routes
steps.expected: UI exposes current-run audit detail such as snapshot/run identity, freshness timing, and provenance for current inputs where available
steps.observed: All six routes exposed audit-oriented trust detail including policy, snapshot/run identifiers or generated timestamps, as-of freshness cues, and per-signal provenance/readiness entries. Some routes also explicitly showed unavailable live feeds without hiding the degraded state.

summary: Tested 5 trust/provenance assertions across all six assigned case-study routes. All 5 passed: every route exposed visible top-of-page decision framing, inspectable trust/current-run detail, and assumptions/swap-path surfaces without console errors during validation.
